sloka: न बभूव तदा कश्चिद्युयुत्सोरस्य सम्मुखे ।सर्वानाविद्ध्य वित्रस्तांस्ततः शक्रो ऽब्रवीत्सुरान् ।। ७.२८.५ ॥
transliteration: na babhūva tadā kaścidyuyutsorasya sammukhe ।sarvānāviddhya vitrastāṁstataḥ śakro 'bravītsurān ।। 7.28.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, no one dared to stand before him, who was eager to fight, and after he had wounded all the terrified gods, Indra spoke to them.
